forbidden.message: SQL built by concatenation/interpolation in a Dapper call — use a const SQL string with parameters
Database connection created outside <App>.Infrastructure — use IDbConnectionFactory in a repository
try/catch in a controller/endpoint — let the central IExceptionHandler translate exceptions
[AllowAnonymous] / .AllowAnonymous() must be justified with a comment on the same line (// why it is public)
DateTime.Now/Today — inject TimeProvider (FakeTimeProvider in tests) and work in UTC
#pragma warning disable without a justification comment on the same line

recommendedSkills.why: Official .NET team guidance for ASP.NET Core endpoints: HTTP semantics, OpenAPI metadata, .http files.
recommendedSkills.conflicts: Ignore its default of minimal APIs for new projects, its raw ProblemDetails/TypedResults bodies and its Create{Entity}Request naming: cuadrilla uses controllers (unless the profile says otherwise), the ApiResponse<T> envelope and <Feature>Request/<Feature>Response.

recommendedSkills.why: Official .NET team checklist for flaky, over-mocked or assertion-free tests; useful when reviewing test changes.
recommendedSkills.conflicts: None known; cuadrilla's mandatory test list (auth, 400/401/403, regression per bug) still applies.

recommendedSkills.why: Official .NET team procedure for behavior-preserving refactors (renames, moves, extractions) verified by build + tests.
recommendedSkills.conflicts: Keep the 4-project dependency rule and the architecture test; a refactor never moves SQL out of Infrastructure or logic into controllers.
